name: danwo-example-better-auth
description: Self-hosted sign-in with Better Auth: a Vite and React app, a Hono API on Postgres, emailed codes through Resend, and Google and GitHub sign-in, all emulated.

scripts.matrix: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "signs up with an emailed code"
scripts.matrix:plan: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "signs up with an emailed code" --plan
scripts.matrix:password: danwo matrix tests/deterministic.danwo.ts --grep "signs up with a password"
